title: The possibility of a Patriots game in Scotland is in the "conversation" phase

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: The possibility of a Patriots game in Scotland is in the "conversation" phase
sources.description: After the Tartan Army took over Boston for the World Cup, and drank all the beer, Patriots owner Robert Kraft expressed an interest to the NFL in playing a game in Scotland.
